scope: Persistent domain grants and structural delegation
invariant: Each authorized operation has one active grant chain, and every delegated grant narrows its parent's explicitly delegable authority.
required_evidence: Both authorized hosts in Debug and ASan/UBSan
Full P00-P10 baseline and unchanged locked assertions
Real SQLite persistence, restart, process death, and transactional failure
Structural scope, rights and depth attenuation, and administration separation
Parent revocation, inactive ancestors, and surviving independent grants
A counterexample detects removal of ancestor revocation enforcement
limitations: The store does not authenticate caller-supplied actor references.
The fixture driver is not an actor endpoint or a world implementation.
Worldd and workspaced integration remains required.
Nonempty bootstrap profiles and live cancellation remain required.
This component does not implement resource budgets or distributed revocation acknowledgement.
